stemMd: A hearing lasts 1 hour 42 minutes. Express the duration in hours.
explanationMd: Convert 42 minutes to 42/60=0.7 hours and add the first hour. Clock notation is not a decimal fraction of an hour.

distractorRationale.d: Adds hours and minutes using the wrong base.
distractorRationale.b: Treats minutes as hundredths of an hour.
distractorRationale.a: Misplaces the decimal in the minute conversion.
